verdict.rationale: Stripe documents webhooks: you register an endpoint and Stripe pushes real-time events to it so your integration can trigger reactions automatically. That supports event-driven automation, but the rules and actions live in your own code, not in a built-in rule definition layer. missing for 10: a native rule or workflow builder for defining event-triggered actions, Terminal-specific event automation docs (e.g., reader or payment events), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
